hints.title: Separating Left and Right Disjoint Palindromes
hints.text: The two odd-length palindromes cannot overlap, dividing the string at an index boundary into a left prefix and right suffix.

hints.title: Manacher Algorithm for Odd Palindrome Radii
hints.text: Run Manacher algorithm to determine the maximal odd-length palindrome radius centered at each character in linear time.

hints.title: Monotonic Prefix and Suffix Maxima
hints.text: Calculate left[i] as the longest odd palindrome ending on or before i, and right[i] as the longest starting on or after i.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Manacher algorithm with linear propagation of prefix and suffix maximum lengths.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Expanding around centers independently takes O(N^2) time, which times out for N = 100,000.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Manacher algorithm computes all palindrome radii in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should utilize Manacher algorithm and propagate lengths to boundaries.
